# May Solutions

> May Solutions is a software development and IT consulting company based in Riedberg, Frankfurt am Main, Germany. It builds custom web platforms, online shops and AI / computer-vision features and advises on software architecture, for companies in Frankfurt, the Rhein-Main region and across Europe, in German and English. (Deutsch: Softwareentwicklung und IT-Beratung in Riedberg, Frankfurt am Main.)

## What May Solutions does

- Web development: web applications and online shops end to end (interface, API, database, delivery pipeline). Reference: frontend lead for the Mercedes-Benz online shop.
- IT consulting: system and software architecture design, reviews of architecture, code and delivery pipelines, and hands-on implementation alongside the client's team.
- AI & vision: machine-learning and computer-vision features taken into production. Reference: state-of-the-art AI for thinkcell.
- Working mode: agile delivery, short iterations, working software early.

## Location and area served

- Headquarters: Riedberg, Frankfurt am Main, Hessen, Germany (the city's science district, home of the Goethe University campus).
- Serves: Frankfurt am Main, the Rhein-Main region, Germany and Europe.
- Languages: German, English.

## Clients

SOKA-BAU, Mercedes-Benz.io, LBBW, GitLab, Bilfinger, thinkcell.

## Technologies

TypeScript, Vue, React, Angular, Next.js, Node.js, Python, Spring Boot, Flask, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL, Supabase, Firebase, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, TensorFlow, PyTorch, OpenCV, FFmpeg.
